item.title: Tributes pour in for civil rights leader Rev. Jesse Jackson after his death at 84
item.description: The Rev. Jesse Jackson, the Baptist minister and longtime civil rights advocate who twice pursued the Democratic nomination for president, has died at 84. His family said he passed away peacefully Tuesday morning, surrounded by loved ones.
